trigger: Primary Hyperliquid Events documentation identifies the account-level forced-liquidation delta as ledgerLiquidation with accountValue, leverageType and liquidatedPositions[{coin,szi}]. The frozen parser instead matched type=liquidation and required an undocumented liquidatedNtlPos field, which could falsely report zero or malformed events. No authoritative Hyperliquid event row, Bybit price, label, model, action, trade or PnL had opened.

correction.optional_field: liquidatedNtlPos is preserved only when present and finite-positive; it is never required or invented
correction.notional_policy: When explicit notional is absent, retain signed coin size and account state. Any later notional feature must be derived only after a causal point-in-time price join in the separately frozen model stage.
correction.individual_fill_boundary: Per-fill liquidation executions belong to the separate TRADES stream and are not inferred from this Events source gate.

unchanged: same immutable convert/parquet revision and exact 36 _src identities
same six dates and six frozen UTC hours per date
same account-level event identity and duplicate definition
same mechanical forced-flow sign: positive liquidated position size implies forced sell, negative size implies forced buy
same prohibition on market price, future return, labels, model metrics, PnL, official 2026 and orders
primary_source: QuickNode Hyperliquid Events Dataset documentation, Liquidation Operations: ledgerLiquidation(accountValue, leverageType, liquidatedPositions[{coin,szi}])
